# ADR 0001 — Fixture: a status block over budget

> **Status:** Accepted — and then amended, and amended again, and again.
> Phase 1 shipped the thing. Phase 2 shipped the other thing. Phase 3 walked
> back half of phase 2. Phase 4 re-shipped it under a different name because
> the first name was taken. Phase 5 is the one where somebody notices that
> this paragraph is now the changelog it was never supposed to become, which
> is exactly the mega-status anti-pattern the guard exists to reject: six
> physical lines, well past the three-line and four-hundred-character budget
> that wiki/standards/documentation-governance.md sets for this field.
> **Date:** 2026-01-01

## Context

Deliberately invalid input for the `adr-status` guard. Nothing reads this as
a real decision record — see scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/README.md.
